[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Design HashSet** [LC 705 · Design HashSet](https://leetcode.com/problems/design-hashset/){difficulty="Easy"}

A set only needs one bit per possible key, so with keys up to $10^6$ a **bit array** of $10^6 + 1$ bits (125 KB) is a complete answer. When the universe is too large for that, store the keys themselves in the table's cells: **open addressing** probes `h(k), h(k)+1, h(k)+2, …` until it finds the key or an empty cell. A deleted key must leave a **tombstone**, not an empty cell, or a later search would stop early and miss keys that were placed beyond it (@sec-ds-a4).

[Solved in full in @sec-ds-p4-hashset.]{.card-link}

:::
